first-launch.title: First launch
first-launch.excerpt: How to connect your keys in Enterprise settings and switch on video, images, voiceover, avatars and trends.
first-launch.lead: TrendTraffic runs on the “bring your own key” model: every paid or cloud step (AI video, images, voiceover, avatars, trend scanning) uses your own provider key, stored encrypted. The free CPU chain (trimming, subtitles, export) needs no keys at all. All keys live in one place — Enterprise settings. Below is what each tab does and how to set it up.

intro.title: What Enterprise settings are and how to open them
intro.body:
Enterprise settings gather all integrations, keys and AI parameters for your account in one screen. Open it from the gear icon at the bottom of the left sidebar, or go straight to app.trendtraffic.pro/settings/enterprise. The section is available on the Enterprise plan (and to the superadmin).

Every key is stored encrypted and shown masked (for example AIzaSy…***). You can re-check or delete any key at any time — nothing is used without your action.
examples: Open settings: click the gear icon at the bottom of the left sidebar.
Don't see the section? It is Enterprise-only — check your plan on the Pricing page (/billing).
Every card has Save, Check/Validate and Delete — a key never leaves your account and can be removed in one click.

api.title: API — your Google Gemini key
api.body:
The API tab holds your personal Google Gemini key from AI Studio. Gemini is the analytical brain of the platform: frame-by-frame video analysis, transcripts, translation and text generation. Your key is used instead of the shared platform key for every Gemini call on your account.

The same tab also holds Quest Flow API keys (secrets for HTTP blocks), the image-generation model selector (for example Nano Banana or Imagen) and a Telegram bot token for notifications.
api.keyLabel: Get a key in Google AI Studio
examples: Paste the AI Studio key and press “Save and validate” — the status turns to “Active”.
Analyse a trend video frame by frame (Gallery → open a video → Analysis) — it runs on your Gemini quota.
Choose “Nano Banana (2.5 Flash Image)” as the image model for generating and editing pictures.
Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token — get a Telegram message when auto-runs finish or a key stops working.

mcp.title: MCP — connect Claude and external AI agents
mcp.body:
The fast path is the “Claude Connector (MCP)” card in your regular account Settings. The “Create personal key” button issues a personal vbvx_mcp_… key with full permissions; the key is shown only once and is already inserted into the ready-made snippets below it: a config for Claude Desktop (claude_desktop_config.json) and a one-line command for Claude Code. Paste it — and the TrendTraffic tools appear right in your Claude chat: trends, gallery, audience, publisher.

Fine-grained permissions live on the MCP tab of Enterprise settings: separate keys with selectable scopes (read trends, read the gallery, generate images and more) for n8n, ChatGPT connectors or custom agents. The connection URL is app.trendtraffic.pro/api/mcp. Keys are stored hashed; deleting a key instantly cuts off that integration.
examples: Settings → “Claude Connector (MCP)” → “Create personal key”; copy the ready config into claude_desktop_config.json (Windows: %APPDATA%\Claude\) and restart Claude Desktop.
Claude Code — connect with one command: copy the “claude mcp add … trendtraffic …” line from the same card and run it in a terminal.
Ask Claude: “scan trends in my niche” or “show my latest gallery files” — it acts through your account.
For n8n or ChatGPT connectors, create a separate key on the Enterprise → MCP tab with only the scopes you need (for example, read-only).
Rotation: delete a key (trash icon) — the integration stops at once; then issue a new one.

tikhub.title: Tikhub — your Trend key
tikhub.body: The Tikhub tab stores your own TikHub.io key for scanning trends and downloading videos from TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. It is used instead of the shared key, on your own quota. The Validate button calls TikHub live and shows the status and remaining balance.
examples: Paste the Trend key and press “Validate” — check the status and your remaining balance.
Scan trends by region and audience (Gallery → Trends) on your own quota.
Paste a TikTok / Instagram / YouTube link into Trends search to download and auto-analyse the video.
Analyse every video of a channel at once (Channels) — powered by the same key.

generation.title: Generation — the extension and render keys
generation.body:
The Generation tab holds the keys for paid or cloud rendering steps: AI video, images, voiceover and avatars. The free CPU chain (trimming, subtitles, formatting, export) needs no keys.

At the top is the TrendTraffic browser extension — one extension for both Google Flow (Veo) and NotebookLM. Below it, the AI Director (Anthropic Claude) — the brain behind smart script steps: research, best-moment selection, scripts and news (default Claude Opus). Then the paid providers: FAL.ai, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, HeyGen and more. Each provider card has Save, Check and Delete.
examples: Install the extension (“Download extension”) to unlock free Veo video through Google Flow and the Hotebook block.
Add an Anthropic Claude key (console.anthropic.com) — it powers scripts, research and news in the smart LLM nodes.
Add ElevenLabs (voiceover, music, SFX) and HeyGen (avatars) keys for the UGC studio.
Add FAL.ai (FLUX, Veo, Kling, MiniMax) for AI image and video generation.
No keys yet? The free CPU chain still trims, subtitles, formats and exports without any provider key.

hotebook.title: Hotebook — Google NotebookLM
hotebook.body:
The Hotebook tab connects the Hotebook block to your own Google NotebookLM through the same TrendTraffic extension, running in your browser under your Google login. Each account has its own connection and its own limits. The status shows one of: connected, extension offline, or sign-in needed.

Tip: use a separate Google account with a Google AI plan — the daily NotebookLM limits (audio / video / chat) are counted per account. The platform never stores your Google cookies; the login stays in your browser.
examples: Install the extension, open notebooklm.google.com and sign in — the “TrendTraffic → Hotebook” panel appears.
Generate audio or video overviews from your sources and pull the results into the Gallery.
Keep the NotebookLM tab open while the block works — sources, chat and generation run inside it.
Press “Check” on this tab if the status is stuck — it re-reads the live connection.
